content_text:
Hey Roger,
I’m about to film a proof of concept which involves alot of kids on bikes.
I only have access to an easy rig and a smallrig car suction cup kit, do you have any ideas on how best to get smooth shots of cast on bikes.
Currently planning on driving and filming from the car for group shots or clamping the camera to the front of a bike for a shot of the one rider.
Thanks so much I love this forum!
